title: Michele Sindona's money laundering operation

tellings.quote: And it's used to do the world's biggest money laundering operation ever, 200 billion dollars according to the author Paul Williams.

plain: A financier named Michele Sindona is said to have run, from around 1964, what one teller calls the world's biggest money laundering operation ever, moving about 200 billion dollars. A researcher named Jason Simosa repeats the figure from the author Paul Williams. He brings it up as part of a larger story linking hidden money to secret power.
